newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Stahl sees H2 pretax well below H1.
newsitem.headline: VA Stahl sees H2 pretax well below H1.

text.p: Austrian steelmaker VA Stahl AG said on Friday it expected to post a significantly lower group pre-tax profit in the second half compared to the first half of the year.

"We will conclude the second half with positive earnings although they will be significantly below the level posted in the first half," VA Stahl said in a statement released before its earnings conference.
Earlier, VA Stahl said first-half pre-tax profit fell to 1.33 billion schillings from 1.94 billion in the year-ago period.

VA Stahl said that it expects to have reached the bottom in the third quarter, where prices of individual products have fallen to levels last seen in the steel industry's particularly tough year of 1993.
VA Stahl stock was down 3.03 percent, or 10 schillings, at 320 on turnover of 19,570 lots by 0749 GMT. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 254
